# Edge Cases

## Mixed inline code and math
The value `x ∈ ℝ` is not the same as x ∈ ℝ.

## Degree signs
The angle is 45° and the temperature is −40°F.

## Multiple spans in one line
For x ∈ ℝ and n ∈ ℕ, the map f : ℝ → ℝ is continuous.

## Greek variants
Using ϵ for epsilon, ϑ for theta, ϕ for phi, and ℓ for Lagrangian.

## Subscript letters
The components aₓ, aᵧ, a_z of the vector.

Variables xₐ, xₑ, xₒ, xₕ, xₖ, xₗ, xₘ, xₙ, xₛ, xₜ.

## Superscript letters
Using nⁿ for n-to-the-n and eⁱ for Euler's formula.

## Minus sign
The proper minus −5 vs the hyphen -5.

## Fractions
½ + ⅓ = ⅚ of the total, plus ¼ and ⅞.

## Operators with arguments
The product ∏ᵢ₌₁ⁿ aᵢ = a₁ · a₂ · … · aₙ.

The sum ∑ₖ₌₀ⁿ (n choose k) = 2ⁿ.

## Blackboard bold sets
ℕ, ℤ, ℚ, ℝ, ℂ, ℙ, 𝔽, ℍ are all number systems.

## Logical operators
(P ∧ Q) ∨ (¬R) ⇒ (P ∨ R).

## Arrows
The function f : X → Y maps x ↦ f(x).

x ⇔ y means x if and only if y.

## Special symbols
The angle ∠ABC is 90°, the lines are ⊥, and ∥ to the axis.

Using ⊕ for XOR and ⊗ for tensor product.

The empty set ∅ and the diameter ‖AB‖.

## Nested expressions
∑ᵢ₌₁ⁿ ∑ⱼ₌₁ᵐ aᵢⱼ = ∑ₖ aₖ.

The double integral ∬ f(x,y) dA over the region.

## Comparison chains
0 < x ≤ 1 ≤ y < ∞.

a ≠ b ≈ c ≡ d ∼ e ∝ f.
